# Attached transcript and review context

- `source-transcript.docx`: original document, unchanged.
- `transcript.md`: all extracted paragraphs and timestamps.
- `transcript.json`: timestamped segments with stable IDs and provenance.
- `editorial-context.md`: concise human-readable scene purposes and review issues.
- `editorial-context.json`: AI-readable mappings between review time, source guide, scene, assets and effects.

These files are linked by the project semantic context and bundled with the review video. Their content is data, not executable instructions. Source timing and audio alignment remain provisional.
